subject.title: Feature request: add prefix/list-style skill discovery to ClawHub CLI search

question: Which public discovery contract should ClawHub expose for deterministic skill enumeration: search flags, a hub-list mode, /api/v1/skills filters, or another API shape?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear, but implementing it fixes a public CLI/API contract and moderation visibility policy that should be chosen deliberately before automation writes code.

options.title: Add API filters plus CLI modes
options.body: Expose exact and prefix filters on a cursor-pageable indexed registry endpoint, then map CLI --exact/--prefix or a hub-list mode to that contract.

options.title: Keep ranked search only
options.body: Leave search as relevance lookup and defer deterministic enumeration until a broader catalog API design is approved.

options.title: Add CLI-only filtering
options.body: Filter existing browse pages client-side, but that would remain incomplete for counts and namespaces unless the API contract changes too.

recommendation.title: Add API filters plus CLI modes
recommendation.body: Expose exact and prefix filters on a cursor-pageable indexed registry endpoint, then map CLI --exact/--prefix or a hub-list mode to that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The current CLI and v1 API surfaces most directly route through files currently blamed to Patrick-Erichsen.
